title: Single Row Keyboard
description: Calculate total time to type a word using a single-row keyboard given a custom layout.

steps.note: Initialize map to store indices of keyboard characters.
Initialize totalTime=0 and current finger position curr=0.
Move from index 0 to index 2. Time: |2-0| = 2.
Move from index 2 to index 1. Time: 2 + |1-2| = 3.
Move from index 1 to index 0. Time: 3 + |0-1| = 4.
